steps.en: Driver notices due for the 3rd letter are selected
steps.id: Notice driver yang jatuh tempo surat ke-3 dipilih

steps.en: Only mailable driver notices go into the file
steps.id: Hanya notice driver yang bisa dikirimi surat masuk file

steps.en: A data file for the printing vendor is built
steps.id: File data untuk vendor percetakan dibuat

steps.en: The file goes to the printing vendor over SFTP
steps.id: File dikirim ke vendor percetakan lewat SFTP
steps.why_en: In the production settings the upload to the printing vendor is blocked, so the file does not leave.
steps.why_id: Di pengaturan produksi upload ke vendor percetakan diblokir, jadi file tidak keluar.

steps.en: The notice moves on once the letter file is delivered
steps.id: Notice maju setelah file surat terkirim
steps.why_en: While the vendor upload is blocked, the notice still moves on although nothing was delivered.
steps.why_id: Selama upload ke vendor diblokir, notice tetap maju padahal tidak ada yang terkirim.
